services.name: SceneResource_LoadCommonPlaneC000
services.behavior: Decompresses the fixed ROM resource at 0x0012F4EC into VRAM 0xC000 through RNC_To_VDP_Loader.

services.name: VDP_CopyIndirectWordStream
services.behavior: Programs VDP control word 0x70000003 and emits 0x200 words from the caller's A1 stream; an FFFF source word is an indirect escape that loads the next word through the following pointer.

services.name: VDP_CopyScenePlaneF800
services.behavior: Copies 0x400 words from ROM source 0x00129F00 to VRAM destination 0xF800 through VDP_CopyWordsToVRAM.

services.name: SceneResource_PrepareBlankFrame
services.behavior: Clears VRAM C000, clears the scene-resource C000 source pointer, and prepares the shared blank palette frame from 0x00128ED2.

services.name: SceneResource_CopyFixedBlockToD000
services.behavior: Copies 0x800 words from fixed ROM source 0x0011E0A0 to VRAM destination 0xD000 through VDP_CopyWordsToVRAM.

conclusion: The scene/resource transfer layer now exposes its indirect VDP stream format, fixed F800 plane transfer, and blank-frame preparation contract without assigning names to state-specific compressed resource loaders.
